action.layout_note: piperx has 7 arm/gripper controls; runtime.action_layout is authoritative.

reset.variation: none; seed is provenance only, not a reset randomization input

spec: 16 fixed equal sectors, score values, mass=2.5 kg, gravity and contact friction
fixed ALOHA complete floor stand, no initialization noise
20 Hz, 200 s, first settlement ends Episode
sampling domains and conditional selection rules
episode_instance: identical explicit initial_state; no scene randomization or round plan

rules.start: not spinning AND robot contact AND abs(angular_speed)>0.10 rad/s
rules.contact: includes any physics-substep contact in the control tick; either arm counts
rules.free_coast: after last contact: time>=1 s AND abs(unwrapped angle minus first no-contact sample angle)>=pi/3; recontact clears coast, does not fail immediately
rules.settle: spinning AND no contact AND abs(angular_speed)<0.01 continuously >=1 s; interruption resets timer
rules.score: first settlement yields sector value if valid coast, else 0; terminal at every score
rules.sectors: phi=(angle-ring_yaw) mod 2pi; left closed right open; 100 at local [157.5,180) degrees
rules.timeout: 4000 ticks; if no settlement score=0, truncated; settlement on final tick takes precedence
rules.nonfinite: unified replay aborts invalid run, not a zero score
rules.feasibility: three-layer and interface checks only; no ALOHA controller success certification

task.success: released free coast of at least 60 degrees, then settled on 100

implementation_status.note: Initial sector depends on selected score. Geometry uses uniform XY scale. Actual inertia = base inertia * scale squared. Score ring rotates; pointer starts facing unchanged arm.

initialization.selection: uniform score, then uniform matching sector, then uniform position within sector
